theme.label: Theme
language.label: Language
language.notLoaded: The language could not be loaded. Try again.
signIn.notCompleted: The sign-in was not completed. If you did not go back yourself, this account may have no access to Build Analyzer.
signIn.stateMismatch: That sign-in did not start here, or took too long. Please sign in again.
signIn.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this server.
error.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.sign_in_required: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.local_only: Sign-in is switched off on this server (auth mode "none"), so it only answers its own pages on the computer it runs on.
error.no_access: Your account has no access to the build analyzer. Ask the owner to add you.
error.admin_only: Only an admin can do this.
error.too_many_imports: That is a lot of imports in one minute. Wait a moment and try again.
error.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell the admin.
error.not_set_up: The build analyzer has not been set up yet. Open /setup.php to set it up.
error.invalid: Some of what was sent is not valid. Check it and try again.
recommendation.weapon_unlisted: {weapon_label}: {name} is not on this build's list. Recommended: {options}.
recommendation.weapon_unlisted_owned: {weapon_label}: {name} is not on this build's list. Recommended: {options}. You already own {owned} ({refinement}).
recommendation.weapon_unlisted_owned_on: {weapon_label}: {name} is not on this build's list. Recommended: {options}. You already own {owned} ({refinement}), currently on {character}.
recommendation.weapon_better_owned_on: You own {owned} ({refinement}), currently on {character} (#{owned_rank}), which ranks above {name} (#{rank}).
recommendation.weapon_low_rank: {name} is option #{rank}. Upgrades to aim for: {options}.
recommendation.sets_missing_empty: {set_label}: use the recommended {best}. Nothing is equipped now.
recommendation.sets_lower_option: {set_label}: yours ({current}) is option #{rank}. The top choice is {best}.
recommendation.main_stat_missing: No {slot_label} equipped. Look for one with {wanted}.
recommendation.main_stat_wrong: {slot_label} has {stat} as main stat; this build wants {wanted}.
recommendation.substats_weak: Your {slot_label} has weak substats ({percent}% of an ideal piece). Replace it with one rolling {stats}.
recommendation.character_level: Level the character up (level {level}); most of their stats come from character level.
import.error.account_missing: The selected account does not exist.
import.error.account_game_mismatch: The selected account is a {account_game} account, but the data is from {data_game}.
import.error.account_uid_mismatch: The data belongs to UID {data_uid}, but the selected account is UID {account_uid}.
import.error.unexpected: The import stopped with an unexpected error.
import.error.uid_invalid: A UID is 9 or 10 digits long.
import.error.showcase_unreachable: The showcase service cannot be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
import.error.showcase_uid_refused: The showcase service did not accept the UID.
import.error.showcase_player_not_found: No player with this UID exists (check the UID and the game).
import.error.showcase_maintenance: The game is under maintenance or just updated, so showcases cannot be read right now. Try again later.
import.error.showcase_busy: Too many showcase requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
import.error.showcase_down: The showcase service is having problems right now. Try again later.
import.error.showcase_http: The showcase service answered with HTTP {status}.
import.error.showcase_bad_answer: The showcase service returned an unexpected answer.
import.error.showcase_details_off: The profile shows characters, but "Show Character Details" is turned off. Enable it in-game (Profile > Character Showcase) and try again in a few minutes.
import.error.showcase_empty: This profile has no characters in its Character Showcase. Add characters in-game (Profile > Character Showcase), enable "Show Character Details", then try again.
import.error.showcase_empty_hsr: This profile shows no characters. In-game open Phone > Profile, add characters to the Character Showcase and Support Characters, then try again in a few minutes.
import.error.good_not_good: This is not a GOOD file (missing "format": "GOOD").
import.error.good_empty: The GOOD file contains no characters or artifacts. Check the exporter settings.
import.error.hsr_not_export: This is not a Star Rail inventory export (it has no "relics" and "light_cones").
import.error.hsr_empty: The export contains no characters or relics. Check the scanner settings.
import.error.file_not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
import.error.file_unknown_format: Unknown file format. Upload a Genshin Impact inventory export in the GOOD format, or a Honkai: Star Rail inventory export (with "relics" and "light_cones").
import.error.file_game_mismatch: This file contains {file_game} data, but you chose {chosen_game}.
import.warning.catalog_behind: What the game catalog does not know yet was skipped. After an admin refreshes the catalog (Sources page), import again.
import.warning.showcase_artifact_skipped: Skipped an artifact with unknown data.
import.warning.showcase_relic_skipped: Skipped a relic with unknown data.
import.warning.good_traveler_no_element: The file has a Traveler without an element (old GOOD version); it was skipped.
import.warning.good_artifacts_skipped: Artifacts skipped for a missing set, slot or main stat: {count}
import.warning.hsr_relics_skipped: Relics skipped for an unknown slot, set or main stat: {count}
